reason: The document-chasing automation is the one thing here I actually want, but I am not putting the intake for my clients' grant files on a system run by someone who does this 10-12 hours a week around a day job. My WordPress site is ugly and it still brings nothing in, because my clients come from referrals and from events like this one, so 4,000-plus EUR in the first year is a lot to pay to fix a problem I do not have.
objection: A grant call closes on a fixed day; if the upload link or the calendar booking breaks the week before a deadline, 'answered within one working day' is a day I do not have, and if he gets a better job or has exams I am left with a site and two automations nobody maintains.
would_change_my_mind: A named second person or company who takes over support and the automations if he stops, written into the contract, plus a reference call with one of the first two clients after they have been live for six months.
